data.raw_text: TRAFFIC ADVISORY (Downtown) - KUB crews will implement a temporary road closure on a short section of West Vine Avenue between South Gay Street and Summit Hill Drive daily from 8 a.m. – 3 p.m., October 28 – November 4, as work is performed on the water system. Alternate routes include South Gay Street, Walnut Street, and Summit Hill Drive. Traffic control measures, including flaggers, barricades, and signage, will be in place to assist with maintaining traffic flow. Access to businesses will be maintained.
